markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the performance occurs.
markets.rules_primary: If Kanye West / Ye performs at Madison Square Garden (MSG) between February 20, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET and December 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary: For purposes of this contract, "performed" means the person appears live on stage or in the official broadcast/stream and performs (including singing, dancing, DJ-ing, or playing an instrument), either as a scheduled performer or as a guest appearance during another artist's performance. Guest appearances where the person performs live music qualify. Festival appearances that include a live set qualify. The following do not qualify: appearing only as an award presenter or host, being in the audience without performing, having music played without participation, appearing in video montages or tribute segments without performing, pre-show or post-show performances outside the official event timeframe, appearances without performing (speeches, award acceptances, interviews, promotional events), canceled or postponed shows where no performance occurs in the time period, rehearsals and sound checks, or virtual participation via livestream into the venue.
markets.title: Will Kanye West / Ye perform at Madison Square Garden (MSG) between February 20, 2026 at 10:00 AM ET and December 31, 2026 at 11:59 PM ET?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close early if Pyth Network reports a qualifying USD/MXN price above the threshold during the observation window.
markets.rules_primary: If the USD/MXN exchange rate published by Pyth Network is above 24 Mexican pesos per U.S. dollar at any point after issuance and before January 1, 2027 at 10:00 AM EST, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market measures threshold crossings after issuance and before January 1, 2027 at 10:00 AM EST. A single qualifying Pyth Network FX.USD/MXN aggregate price strictly greater than 24 Mexican pesos per U.S. dollar is sufficient for Yes. Otherwise, the market resolves to No after the observation window ends.

Prices are rounded to four decimal places. The aggregate/midpoint price governs; the confidence interval does not establish a crossing. Prices before issuance do not count.

If the feed becomes unavailable, is deprecated, or is materially altered, the Exchange may use a substantially equivalent replacement feed published by Pyth Network, with notice to Members, as provided in the contract. If an Expiration Value cannot be determined, Rule 7.1 applies. Revisions made after expiration do not count.

The latest expiration is one week after the final observation date, at 10:00 AM ET. Expiration may move earlier after a qualifying crossing in accordance with Rule 7.2. Settlement is no later than the day after expiration unless the outcome is under review.
markets.title: Will USD/MXN exceed 24 before Jan 1, 2027 at 10:00 AM EST?

markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary: If the U.S. holiday-season net retail jobs added for September–December 2026 is above 400,000 jobs, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market measures the net increase in U.S. retail trade payroll employment from September–December 2026 using BLS’s not-seasonally-adjusted “All employees, retail trade” series (CEU4200000001).

The expiration value is the first published December 2026 level, converted from thousands to individual jobs, minus the fixed September baseline of 15,378,400 jobs. The initial December estimate is used even if labeled preliminary. Later corrections, revisions, and benchmark updates to either month are ignored. No additional rounding applies.

The measure includes seasonal and nonseasonal jobs and reflects net employment growth, not gross hires or announced hiring plans.
markets.title: Will U.S. holiday-season net retail jobs added for September–December 2026 be above 400,000?
